intentEvidence: SlashComplete is meant as a replacement to the existing Notion slash commands plugin to solely focus on Markdown support.
problem: Users need a fast, keyboard-driven way to insert complex Markdown structures and commands without manually typing them out.

relations.evidence: SlashComplete is meant as a replacement to the existing Notion slash commands plugin to solely focus on Markdown support.

summary: Provides Notion-style slash command autocompletion to allow users to quickly insert Markdown blocks, formatting, and commands directly into the editor.
